sundai:fc:181.question: She still _____ the way he treated her years ago.
sundai:fc:181.fullSentence: She still resents the way he treated her years ago.

sundai:fc:182.question: There was a general _____ among the committee members.
sundai:fc:182.fullSentence: There was a general consensus among the committee members.

sundai:fc:183.question: The newspaper published a _____ story to boost sales.
sundai:fc:183.fullSentence: The newspaper published a sensational story to boost sales.

sundai:fc:184.question: He is very _____ to criticism, so be careful what you say.
sundai:fc:184.fullSentence: He is very sensitive to criticism, so be careful what you say.

sundai:fc:185.question: 「拒否する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:185.fullSentence: She refused to answer any more questions.
sundai:fc:185.explanation: refuse: 拒否する。confuse: 混乱させる。diffuse: 拡散させる。transfuse: 輸血する。

sundai:fc:186.question: I was completely _____ by his confusing instructions.
sundai:fc:186.fullSentence: I was completely confused by his confusing instructions.

sundai:fc:187.question: The scientist tried to _____ the theory with new evidence.
sundai:fc:187.fullSentence: The scientist tried to refute the theory with new evidence.
sundai:fc:187.explanation: refute: 論駁する。refund: 返金する。

sundai:fc:188.question: 「変換する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:188.fullSentence: We plan to convert this old barn into a house.
sundai:fc:188.explanation: convert: 変換する。divert: それる、転用する。avert: 回避する。

sundai:fc:189.question: The city has a _____ population from many different countries.
sundai:fc:189.fullSentence: The city has a diverse population from many different countries.
sundai:fc:189.explanation: diverse: 多様な。diversity: 多様性。

sundai:fc:190.question: Quick action _____ a major disaster.
sundai:fc:190.fullSentence: Quick action averted a major disaster.

sundai:fc:191.question: 「物議を醸す」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:191.fullSentence: The new policy has become highly controversial.
sundai:fc:191.explanation: controversial: 物議を醸す。vertical: 垂直の。adversity: 逆境。

sundai:fc:192.question: He remained calm even in the face of great _____.
sundai:fc:192.fullSentence: He remained calm even in the face of great adversity.

sundai:fc:193.question: The new employee's social _____ made her stand out at the party.
sundai:fc:193.fullSentence: The new employee's social status made her stand out at the party.

sundai:fc:194.question: 「かなりの」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:194.fullSentence: There has been a substantial increase in sales this year.
sundai:fc:194.explanation: substantial: かなりの。substance: 物質。

sundai:fc:195.question: The doctor gave her medicine to _____ her heartbeat.
sundai:fc:195.fullSentence: The doctor gave her medicine to stabilize her heartbeat.
sundai:fc:195.explanation: stabilize: 安定させる。stable: 安定した。

sundai:fc:196.question: The two countries agreed to _____ diplomatic relations.
sundai:fc:196.fullSentence: The two countries agreed to establish diplomatic relations.

sundai:fc:197.question: A fallen tree became a major _____ on the road.
sundai:fc:197.fullSentence: A fallen tree became a major obstacle on the road.

sundai:fc:198.question: It is _____ that everyone follows these safety rules.
sundai:fc:198.fullSentence: It is imperative that everyone follows these safety rules.
sundai:fc:198.explanation: imperative: 絶対必要な、命令的な。

sundai:fc:199.question: Only three _____ applied for the position this year.
sundai:fc:199.fullSentence: Only three candidates applied for the position this year.
sundai:fc:199.explanation: candidate: 候補者。candid: 率直な。

sundai:fc:200.question: This custom seems to _____ from an ancient tradition.
sundai:fc:200.fullSentence: This custom seems to derive from an ancient tradition.

sundai:fc:201.question: 「攻撃的な」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:201.fullSentence: The dog became aggressive when strangers approached.

sundai:fc:202.question: The flowers in the vase began to _____ after a week.
sundai:fc:202.fullSentence: The flowers in the vase began to wither after a week.

sundai:fc:203.question: The jury found him _____ of all charges.
sundai:fc:203.fullSentence: The jury found him innocent of all charges.

sundai:fc:204.question: His rude comment tried to _____ me in front of my friends.
sundai:fc:204.fullSentence: His rude comment tried to embarrass me in front of my friends.

sundai:fc:205.question: The disease quickly became a global _____.
sundai:fc:205.fullSentence: The disease quickly became a global pandemic.
sundai:fc:205.explanation: pandemic: パンデミック。panacea: 万能薬。
